name: io.github.googlarz/signal-mcp
title: Signal MCP
description: Signal for AI assistants: search history, send, groups, polls. 100% local, on top of signal-cli.

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow only read-only tools (no sending, editing or deleting).

environmentVariables.name: SIGNAL_MCP_SEND_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Colon-separated folders that files may be sent from. Default: the signal-mcp attachments folder, ~/Downloads, ~/Desktop, ~/Documents.
